crossRefs.note: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.
They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
What the wicked fear, will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees…
Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much…
My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can’t rest and its waters cast up mire and mud.
“There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”
Then the king’s face was changed in him, and his thoughts troubled him; and the joints of his thighs were loosened, and…

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.
translations.bsb: When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was afraid and trembled violently.
translations.kjv: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart greatly trembled.
translations.asv: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.
